title: The Smiling Portrait
author: Theo Dunmore
blurb: Wendell Winterbourne, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
